welcome.vectorBadge: True vector SVG — crisp at any size
welcome.regionBadge: Manual region control — merge and split
welcome.tagline: Create an SVG paint-by-numbers template with manual merge and split controls
welcome.description: Shape every numbered region before you export: merge tiny areas, split broad ones, and download a true vector SVG for Cricut, laser cutting, murals, or any print size.
welcome.feature1Body: Download editable vector paths for Cricut, laser cutting, vinyl, murals, or any print size.
welcome.feature2Body: Click individual regions to combine unwanted fragments or split broad areas before export.
welcome.feature3Body: Map every region to a Crayola crayon preset, or build your own custom palette from scratch.
welcome.feature4Body: Export an outline template or a coloured reference in the format that fits your painting workflow.
welcome.comparePromptLink: Compare SVG export and manual region controls with other generators
welcome.step1: Drag and drop an image below, click to browse, or paste from clipboard.
welcome.step2: Adjust the palette size and other settings in the left-hand panel.
welcome.step3: Click "Generate Paint by Numbers" to process the image.
welcome.step4: Merge or split any regions, then export your template as SVG, PDF, or PNG.

controls.borderingInfo: Adds borders between regions to prevent color bleeding while painting

paintMode.instructions: Tap a color to highlight where it goes, then tap those regions to mark them painted. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can I export a true vector SVG?
faq.a1: Yes. Export editable SVG paths that stay crisp for Cricut, laser cutting, murals, and oversized prints.
faq.q2: Can I merge or split individual regions?
faq.a2: Yes. Refine the generated template by merging small regions or splitting broad ones before export.
faq.a3: Export your finished template as a printable PDF, a PNG image, or a scalable SVG.
faq.q4: Can I use my own colors or match real paints?
faq.a4: Yes. Build a custom palette or map each region to a Crayola crayon preset.
faq.q5: What kind of photo works best?
faq.a5: Photos with a clear subject and strong contrast work best. Fewer colors make simpler templates.

privacy.tagline: Your images are processed entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded or stored on any server.
privacy.author: Phil Denoncourt III
privacy.noDataBody: This application does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. No analytics, no tracking, no cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: This application uses Google Analytics to measure usage (for example page views, processing runs, and export actions). Uploaded images are still processed locally in your browser and are not sent to our server.
privacy.localStorageBody: Your current session (settings and image) may be saved to your browser's localStorage for convenience. This data never leaves your device and can be cleared at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.imagesBody: All image processing is performed locally in your browser using Web Workers. Your images are never sent to a server.
privacy.copyrightBody: You are responsible for ensuring you have the necessary rights to use any images you upload. Do not upload images you do not own or have permission to use.
